# ShineDay: Habit Tracker / 小日常 (App Store ID 1263789061) — Full Review Analysis

**App:** ShineDay: Habit Tracker — *Micro Habits, ADHD & Focus* (Chinese name in the corpus: **小日常**)
**Developer:** Guangzhou Xiaorichang Technology Co., Ltd. · bundle `com.dandelion.Routine`
**Reviews analysed:** 20,634 — every single one · 48 storefronts · 3 Aug 2017 → 7 Sep 2026 (110 calendar months)
**Corpus extracted:** 8 Sep 2026 (`manifest.json`) · **written-review mean 4.25** (13,415×5★, 3,278×4★, 1,498×3★, 570×2★, 1,873×1★)
**Store-level context:** from this repository's ranking snapshot `habit-apps-ranked.json` — **562,951 public ratings at 4.78**, ranked in 45 storefronts, best search rank 2 (Hong Kong), median rank 32, audience "established". No live store page was fetched (§1.6).

---

## How to read this

Every claim carries a count, a % of a stated denominator, a signal label and real review IDs, all resolvable in `app store review/52. ShineDay - Habit Tracker - Micro Habits, ADHD & Focus/reviews.jsonl`. **Part 10 indexes all 20,634 reviews individually**, so any number can be traced back to exact reviews in one step, and any review traced forward to the themes it carries. **Appendix C lists every review ID behind every theme.**

| Band | Label | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| < 0.1% | Ignore | Not promoted unless safety/legal/data-loss |
| 0.1 – 0.5% | Weak signal | Recorded, cautious wording |
| 0.5 – 1% | Emerging | Worth investigating |
| 1 – 3% | Meaningful | Strong candidate |
| 3 – 5% | Very strong | Should shape roadmap |
| > 5% | High-priority | Strong problem or opportunity |

Theme counts are **non-exclusive** — 34,191 assignments over 20,634 reviews (1.66 per review, median 1). Global percentages always divide by **20,634**; segment rates are labelled as such and always shown with the global count.

Quotes are given in the original language first; English translations are the analyst's and are marked *EN*.

### ⚠️ Eight warnings before any number here is used

1. **This is a mainland-China corpus.** 19,669 of 20,634 reviews (95.32%) come from the `cn` storefront and 19,858 (96.24%) are written in Chinese. "Global" in this report is, in practice, "China plus 965 reviews from 47 other storefronts". Part 7 separates the two.
2. **Written reviews are 3.67% of public ratings** (20,634 of 562,951). The written mean (4.25) sits 0.53★ below the public average (4.78). That gap is moderate and consistent across storefronts (§7.8), so the written corpus is a negativity-skewed sample, but not a different population.
3. **Almost a quarter of the corpus has no product content.** `META_LOWINFO` = 4,760 (23.07%) — "好", "不错", "好用" and similar. With pre-use and review-to-unlock reviews, **5,479 reviews (26.55%, mean 4.73) carry no product experience** (§3.2). Median review body length is 19 characters. The 5★ band is 30.8% content-free (§5.1).
4. **The launch period was review-gated.** In 2017 the app required a written review to unlock features — mostly reminders. `META_UNLOCK` = 462 (2.24%), of which 427 fall in 2017 (16.0% of that year's reviews). The 15 busiest days in the entire corpus are all between 5 Nov and 13 Dec 2017 (peak 79 reviews on 12 Dec 2017 = 0.38% of corpus). Reviews from that window include keyboard-mash filler written to hit a length requirement. Disclosed in §1.7 and not removed.
5. **Later reviews are also solicited, but not gated.** From 2020 the app prompts for a review on the Nth launch ("第500次打开"). 40 reviews mention such a prompt explicitly (text census, §1.7). Solicitation inflates 5★ volume; it does not change the direction of any finding here.
6. **73 reviews (0.35%, weak) contradict their own rating** — 35 are 5★ complaints and 24 are 1★ praise. They are kept and listed in full (§5.6, Appendix E).
7. **Only six storefronts clear 50 reviews:** cn 19,669 · us 287 · tw 201 · hk 119 · ca 61 · au 53. Every other storefront — including gb (40), sg (27), jp (24), de (22) — is **[limited evidence]**.
8. **No version field exists.** Every release, price change and redesign in Part 8 is reconstructed from what reviewers say and when they say it. 2026 is a partial year (to 7 Sep). `is_edited` is true for 186 records (0.90%); only 323 records (1.57%) have any helpful votes (maximum 63).

---

# PART 0 — READ THIS FIRST

**Executive summary in one line:** 小日常 is a nine-year-old habit tracker that people choose for how it *looks and feels* — clean (`DES_CLEAN` 8.32%) and cute (`DES_CUTE` 6.94%), with no social layer — and whose reviews turn negative almost entirely over **how it makes money**: a free habit quota (`PAY_CAP5` 4.30%), paywalls (`PAY_WALL` 3.47%) and, from June 2025, **aggressive ads (`AD_NEG` 4.29% of the whole corpus, but 35.0% of all reviews written June–November 2025)**. The second failure is **entitlement fragility** — purchases, data and memberships that do not survive a reinstall, a new phone, an iPad or a switch between Android and iOS — made worse by **release-triggered crash waves** that recur roughly every 12–18 months.

## 0.1 The 2025 ad rollout is the largest negative event in nine years

**`AD_NEG` = 885 reviews (4.29%, very strong, mean 2.46; 1/2/3/4/5 = 383/103/139/128/132; 2018-12-27 → 2026-09-04, cn×864).** 575 of the 885 (65.0%) were written in 2025 alone.

| Window | Reviews | `AD_NEG` | Share of window | Mean ★ of window |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Jan–May 2025 | 991 | 6 | 0.6% | **4.59** |
| **Jun–Nov 2025** | **1,562** | **546** | **35.0%** | **3.70** |
| 2026 (to 7 Sep) | 1,341 | 78 | 5.8% | 4.42 |

**July 2025 is the lowest-rated month in the corpus** (362 reviews, mean 3.35; 173 of them `AD_NEG`), followed by June 2025 (3.60). Before 2025 the lowest month was December 2019 (3.61).

Reviewers do not object to ads as such. They describe specific mechanics, repeatedly and independently. The table shows text sub-cuts *inside* the hand-coded `AD_NEG` set, 2025–26 only (§1.5 explains the method):

| Mechanic | Reviews (2025–26) | Representative IDs |
|---|---:|---|
| Ad opens another app automatically (Taobao, Pinduoduo, Meituan, Quark) | 107 | `12831040911` `12886873169` `12914673906` `13362003467` |
| Close / skip button hidden, tiny or ineffective | 88 | `12803944732` `12793111376` `13362003467` `12831040911` |
| Shaking or tilting the phone triggers the ad | 33 | `12831040911` `12829168869` `12739880901` |
| Ad appears after the check-in itself, not only at launch | — (read in window) | `12796570816` `12742750263` `13362003467` |
| Paying members still see ads (coded `AD_NEG` ∩ `PAY_BOUGHT`, all years) | 40 | `12795677855` `14301818772` `13876926025` `4189381643` |

- `12831040911` (cn, 1★, 29 Jun 2025): *"'跳过'和'关闭'的按钮越来越隐蔽…手机稍微动一下，或者扭一下，屏幕稍微侧一下，自动跳入广告页面！！"* — *EN:* "the skip and close buttons get more hidden… move the phone slightly, twist it, tilt the screen a little, and it jumps into the ad page."
- `13362003467` (cn, 1★, 6 Nov 2025): the close button doesn't work, and pressing it opens *"淘宝全屏广告也关不掉"* — *EN:* "a full-screen Taobao ad that also can't be closed". The reviewer then notices the 8-yuan lifetime ad-free SKU and concludes the ads exist to sell it.
- `12795677855` (cn, 1★, 20 Jun 2025): *"以前买了终身会员…现在广告太多！每次打卡都会弹出丑陋广告"* — *EN:* "I bought lifetime membership before… now there are too many ads, an ugly ad pops up at every check-in."
- `12743825635` (us storefront, Chinese text, 3★, 6 Jun 2025): *"用了两年的精品app…广告的插入与app本身用来提高生活品质、让人静下心的初衷背道而驰。对不起，卸载了。"* — *EN:* "a two-year gem… ads contradict the app's purpose of calming you down. Sorry, uninstalled."
- `13229374881` (cn, 1★, 6 Oct 2025): a chronic-illness patient who uses the app to log medication and says the growing ads make it *"对于病人来说很烦躁"* (*EN:* "agitating for a patient").
- The same tolerance threshold shows in the positive reviews that accept the trade: `13284916834` (5★) *"不过8元可以永久免广告"* (*EN:* "but 8 yuan removes ads forever"); `14100445684` (5★) *"充了8块好用多了"* (*EN:* "paid 8 yuan, much better").

**Reading:** the ads were not a pricing decision that users rejected. They were an **interaction-design decision**: auto-jump, motion triggers and a close control that doesn't close. That generated a 35% complaint rate within five months. `AD_NEG` fell back to 5.8% of reviews in 2026, and monthly means recovered to 4.45–4.61 from January to May 2026. Either the mechanics were softened or the complainants had already left. The corpus cannot distinguish the two (§8.5).

Ads were not new in 2025. Splash ads for Ctrip (`4607325416`, 2019) and Pinduoduo (`7038818912`, 2021) produced a smaller wave: `AD_NEG` was 99 reviews (3.4%) in 2020 and 83 (2.8%) in 2021, then fell to 0.2–0.7% in 2022–2024. `8329654441` (2022) even tells others to downgrade to v5.05 to escape ads.

## 0.2 The free habit quota is the persistent monetization friction

**`PAY_CAP5` = 888 (4.30%, very strong, mean 2.96; 1/2/3/4/5 = 257/98/154/180/199).** **`PAY_WALL` = 715 (3.47%, very strong, mean 2.62).** Their union with the other price and entitlement complaints — **monetization friction — is 2,496 reviews (12.10%, high-priority, mean 2.98)** (§3.2).

- The quota is the first wall a new user meets. `2001609740` (cn, 5★, 16 Dec 2017): *"只能免费编辑五个习惯真的有点少了…人认真起来每天想要坚持做的事情想必也不止才五件吧"* — *EN:* "only five free habits is too few… anyone serious wants to keep more than five things a day." `5519779697` (cn, 1★, 2020) and `12892816707` (cn, 1★, 2025) say the same eight years apart.
- **The stated cap moved.** Inside `PAY_CAP5`/`PAY_WALL`, reviewers name "5 habits" in every year from 2018 to 2025 (174 mentions; text sub-cut), but also "4" (2017–2018, 2020–2024), "3" (2020–2021, 2025), "6" (2018), "8" (`13289981450`, 2025) and "10" (2020, 2021, 2025, 2026 — `14081265840`). Reviewers are describing different builds and different cohorts.
- **From 2025 the quota grows with use**, and reviewers who notice it treat it as generosity, not friction. `13125235029` (5★) *"坚持打卡还会赠送习惯数"* (*EN:* "keep checking in and it gives you more habit slots"); `13289981450` (4★) *"我一开始以为是只能用8个习惯，后来发现是会随着使用增加"* (*EN:* "I thought it was capped at 8, then found it grows with use"); `13591116003` (5★) calls the design *"非常善意"* (*EN:* "very kind"). `PAY_CAP5` fell from 8.2% of reviews (2018) and 7.1% (2020) to **0.6% in 2026**. It is the only monetization theme in the corpus with a sustained, monotonic decline.
- **The iOS quota was tighter than Android's**, and switchers noticed. `3853033716` (cn, 1★, 2019): *"安卓添加十几个都没问题，为什么要区别对待呢？"* (*EN:* "on Android I could add a dozen, why treat us differently?").

## 0.3 Paying users are the most satisfied segment — until an entitlement breaks

**`PAY_BOUGHT` = 1,286 (6.23%, high-priority, mean 4.11; 815 of them 5★ = 63.4% segment rate).** 199 of these (15.5% segment rate) explicitly bought a lifetime membership; their mean is 4.36. What payers add, relative to the corpus (lift = segment rate ÷ global rate; §6.1):

| Payers over-index on… | Segment rate (of 1,286) | Global rate | Lift |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `PAY_PRICE_OK` — price is fair / worth it | 5.7% | 1.24% | 4.58 |
| `SOC_NOSOCIAL` — praising the *absence* of social features | 2.6% | 0.58% | 4.55 |
| `DEV_TRUST` — trust in the developer as a reason to pay | 4.0% | 1.03% | 3.92 |
| `DES_THEME` — themes / skins | 6.1% | 1.66% | 3.65 |
| `DES_ICON_WANT` — more icons | 7.7% | 2.72% | 2.83 |
| **`SUP_BAD` — no response from support** | **4.0%** | **0.89%** | **4.53** |
| **`PAY_TIERS` — tier structure confusing / Android-iOS split** | **2.8%** | **0.55%** | **5.11** |
| **`REM_FAIL` — reminders don't fire** | **4.9%** | **1.35%** | **3.62** |
| **`PAY_RESTORE` — membership lost after reinstall / device change** | **3.0%** | **0.92%** | **3.21** |

The first five rows are *why people pay*. The last four are *what goes wrong after they do*. Once one of those happens, payers become the harshest reviewers in the corpus:

| Payer sub-segment | n | Mean ★ |
|---|---:|---:|
| Paid **and** reports value (fair price, trust, clean/cute, outcome) at 4–5★ | 306 | 4.92 |
| Paid **and** an entitlement broke (restore / billing / refund / regression / price rise) | 80 | 2.62 |
| Paid **and** a reliability failure (crash, lag, update, data loss, sync, widget, reminder) | 286 | 3.04 |
| Paid **and** data loss | 33 | **1.73** |
| Paid **and** support never answered | 52 | **1.92** |

**The single most expensive failure is the reinstall path.** A crash leads to a reinstall, which loses local data. Restoring that data asks for membership, and the old membership doesn't restore. 32 reviews say outright that restoring their own data required paying (`6494333470`, `11779820068`, `11764810805`). `11764810805` (cn, 1★, 26 Sep 2024): *"重新安装后为了恢复数据花钱买了永久会员，结果一恢复数据就闪退"* — *EN:* "after reinstalling I bought lifetime membership to restore my data, and restoring crashed the app."

## 0.4 Memberships don't travel across devices or platforms

**`PAY_RESTORE` = 190 (0.92%, emerging, mean 2.61).** `DATA_SYNC_FAIL` = 151 (0.73%, emerging, mean 3.23). `PLAT_ANDROID` = 195 (0.95%, emerging, mean 3.53). `PLAT_MAC` = 37 (0.18%, weak, mean 3.81). **Data integrity union (loss, sync failure or restore failure) = 518 (2.51%, meaningful, mean 2.85).**

- **Android ↔ iOS:** 49 reviews combine `PLAT_ANDROID` with a tier or restore failure (mean 2.80). The membership is sold twice, at different prices, and login methods differ: QQ on Android versus WeChat on iOS (`4353672876`, `6367540210`, `8198718685`). `10530140312` (1★, 2023): *"买了之后才发现安卓会员还需要另行购买"* (*EN:* "only after buying did I find Android membership must be bought separately"). `13791604447` (1★, Feb 2026, title): *"iOS终生会员88，安卓48？天理何在"* (*EN:* "iOS lifetime 88, Android 48? Where's the justice").
- **iPhone ↔ iPad:** 147 reviews combine `PLAT_IPAD` with sync failure, a sync request or a restore failure (0.71%, emerging). `6663079686` (2020): an iPhone membership isn't recognised on iPad. `12506637899` (1★, 2025): a lifetime member reports two years of sync complaints across several feedback channels with no reply.
- **Mac:** 12 reviews report WeChat cannot be bound on the Mac build (2021–2026). The 10-vote review `9113611996` (2022) and the 4-vote review `7733162522` (2021) are among the most-upvoted in the corpus. `12099235782` (1★, Dec 2024): *"三年前就有人提了"* (*EN:* "people raised this three years ago").

## 0.5 Reliability fails in waves, and each wave is a release

**Reliability union = 2,608 reviews (12.64%, high-priority, mean 3.49)** (§3.2). `BUG_CRASH` = 412 (2.00%, meaningful, mean 3.22). **175 of the 412 crash reviews (42.5%) fall in just six of the corpus's 110 months:**

| Month | `BUG_CRASH` | What reviewers describe | Evidence |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Jul 2018 | 25 | Crash on tapping the purchase button; fixed within a day | `2830538942` `2834021219` `2838663501` |
| Oct 2019 | 32 | v2.41 on iOS 13: crash right after Face ID / Touch ID unlock (month mean 3.73) | `4942566618` `4936869831` `4925667389` |
| May 2023 | 26 | v7.14: launch crash for days; reinstall wiped records (month mean 3.76) | `9919428713` `9980189801` `9952880388` |
| Sep 2024 | **44** | Post-update crash on launch or sync; restoring data required buying membership (month mean 3.89) | `11764810805` `11779820068` `11776198730` |
| Apr 2025 | 24 | Post-update launch crash, including the focus space on iOS 14.8 | `12516883329` `12494993872` `12522893732` |
| Sep 2025 | 24 | 20+ days of launch crashes on iOS 14.x devices despite a stated iOS 14 floor | `13185604830` `13180896126` `13148041255` |

A distinct failure on **31 Jul 2023** produced 12 reviews in one day, all saying the update could not be downloaded or reinstalled (`10203240496`, `10204269642`, `10205174382`).

**`DATA_LOSS` = 229 (1.11%, meaningful, mean 2.73; 85 of them 1★).** 56 of those tie the loss directly to an update or crash. `12957540481` (cn, 1★, 31 Jul 2025): after the 28 Jul update *"4年【小事】记录全部消失…特意充的终身会员"* (*EN:* "four years of to-do records all gone… I bought lifetime membership for this").

## 0.6 Simplicity is the product; every redesign is judged against it

**Aesthetic praise union = 3,537 (17.14%, high-priority, mean 4.80)** — `DES_CLEAN` 1,716 (8.32%), `DES_CUTE` 1,431 (6.94%), `DES_PRETTY` 429 (2.08%) and `DES_ICON_LIKE` 321 (1.56%). The users buy exactly this, and it is also what they defend: **interface regression union = 824 (3.99%, very strong, mean 3.58)** — `DES_REDESIGN` 372 (1.80%), `DES_DENSE` 427 (2.07%) and `DES_NEG` 102 (0.49%).

Redesign complaints arrive in bursts that match releases:

| Month | `DES_REDESIGN` | The change reviewers object to | Evidence |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Oct 2020 | 26 | iOS 14 widgets: tap-to-check replaced by a progress ring that opens the app | `6487343139` `6489384630` `6514321794` |
| Jun 2021 | 29 | A check-in now opens a *Success / Pending / Fail* sheet instead of a single tap | `7515737588` `7517368475` `7522832396` `7519571134` |
| Sep–Dec 2024 | 31 | Home layout compressed; widgets and sorting changed | `12024716798` `12065142171` `12062367782` |
| Feb–Apr 2026 | 20 | Several changes, most visibly AI-generated note titles that can't be switched off | `13930545782` `13965180848` `14508025525` |
| Aug 2026 | 12 | Solid-red pomodoro/focus page that clashes with the rest of the app | `14381653023` `14403076784` `14405943569` `14421731886` |

- `7515737588` (cn, 1★, Jun 2021): *"本来用来打卡点一下就好了…现在打个卡最少点两下"* — *EN:* "a check-in used to be one tap… now it's at least two."
- `7519571134` (us, 1★, Jun 2021): *"As a product manager myself… The whole layout is very confusing."*
- `13403164932` (cn, 5★, Nov 2025) proposes the governance fix unprompted: *"有时候迭代之后的风格变动太大了…是否可以考虑…把前端的风格解耦出来"* — *EN:* "style changes too much between iterations… consider decoupling the front-end style."

**`SOC_NOSOCIAL` = 120 (0.58%, emerging, mean 4.85)** reviewers go further and ask that social features *never* be added. The third most-upvoted review in the corpus (`2584511973`, 48 votes) ends with *"千万不要加社交功能，我只想安安静静自己打卡"* — *EN:* "please never add social features, I just want to check in quietly by myself."

## 0.7 The app's international users literally cannot read it

**`LOC_UNTRANS` = 153 globally (0.74%, emerging, mean 3.25), but 100 of the 453 reviews from English-primary storefronts (22.1% segment rate, mean 3.00)** say parts of the app — notifications, pop-ups, prompts, ads — remain in Chinese when the device is set to English. In each eligible non-Chinese storefront it is the **single largest theme**: us 64/287 (22.30%), ca 14/61 (22.95%), au 11/53 (20.75%). All are high-priority at the country denominator (§7.3–§7.7). Taiwan's equivalent is the absence of Traditional Chinese: `LOC_WANT` 46/201 (22.89%, high-priority).

- `3000754446` (us, 1★, 2018): *"All Chinese! I cannot understand a word of this app."*
- `6448767945` (us, 1★, 2020): *"I changed the language to English but I still get a Chinese pop up ad every time I open the app."*
- `11313989030` (us, 1★, 2024), titled *"Malware?? DO NOT INSTALL"*: Chinese UI plus a precise-location permission request made the reviewer conclude the app was malicious.
- `5222510620` (ca, 1★, 2019): *"I'd give 4 or 5 stars"* if everything were in English. It is a rating contradiction caused purely by localisation.

The public average in those storefronts is still 4.65–4.74 (§7.8), so this is not currently sinking the listing. It is, however, the one obstacle named by almost every fourth non-Chinese reviewer.

## 0.8 What works, and who stays

- **Outcomes:** 1,340 reviews (6.49%, high-priority, mean **4.88**) report a real-world result: self-discipline (`OUT_DISCIPLINE` 761, 3.69%), less procrastination (107), fitness (190), study (115) or mental health (57). `OUT_MENTAL` `13578778405` (5★, 31 Dec 2025): *"为了督促抑郁的自己做好日常的小事"* (*EN:* "to push my depressed self to do the small daily things"). `13925038009` (5★, Apr 2026): *"这款好软件曾帮我戒烟577天"* (*EN:* "this app helped me quit smoking for 577 days").
- **Tenure is rising:** `USER_LONGTERM` = 705 (3.42%, very strong, mean 4.63). 460 of these (65.2%) were written in 2024–2026, when long-tenure users were 8.1%, 6.7% and 8.5% of each year's reviews. `14460751570` (5★, Aug 2026): eight years of yoga logged, *"第2000个日常"* (*EN:* "my 2,000th check-in").
- **Honoured lifetime purchases build unusual loyalty:** `DEV_TRUST` = 213 (1.03%, meaningful, mean **4.93** — the highest-mean theme above 100 reviews). `8082408412` (5★, 2021): reinstalled years later, *"心想可能又要花钱买会员了，但是点进去一看：你是终身会员。我真的感动得要哭了"* — *EN:* "I thought I'd have to pay again, but it said: you are a lifetime member. I nearly cried."
- **Reward mechanics are liked and growing:** `STAT_REWARD` (光芒值 "sunshine points" exchanged for self-set rewards) = 312 (1.51%, meaningful, mean 4.65). It rose from 0.1–0.8% of reviews before 2021 to 1.9–3.1% from 2021 on.

## 0.9 The five decisions this corpus supports

1. **Fix the ad mechanics, not the ad model.** Remove motion-triggered and auto-jump ads, make the close control close, never show ads after a check-in or to any payer, and surface the 8-yuan ad-free SKU honestly. Evidence: §0.1 — 546 complaints in six months, the lowest month in nine years, and 40 paying reviewers who still saw ads.
2. **Make one account own the membership and the data**, across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android, and never put restoring a user's *own* records behind a paywall. Evidence: §0.3, §0.4, §6.4.
3. **Put a release gate in front of old-iOS devices and data migrations.** Six crash waves account for 42.5% of all crash reviews, and at least three of them destroyed data (§0.5, §8.4).
4. **Ship new UI as opt-in**, and never remove one-tap check-in. Every redesign wave (2020, 2021, 2024, 2026) was about losing speed or calm, not about losing a feature (§0.6).
5. **Finish the English and Traditional Chinese strings**, starting with notifications and ads. It is the top substantive theme in the us, ca, au and tw storefronts (§0.7).

# PART 1 — SCOPE AND METHOD

## 1.1 Files used

| File | Role | Records |
|---|---|---|
| `app store review/52. ShineDay - Habit Tracker - Micro Habits, ADHD & Focus/reviews.jsonl` | Primary corpus — every review read | 20,634 |
| `.../by_country/*.jsonl` | 48 per-storefront files | 20,634 (reconciled, §1.3) |
| `.../manifest.json` | Extraction metadata, per-country counts, rating distribution | — |
| `.../_state.json` | Per-storefront crawl completeness | 92 storefronts polled, all `complete=true` |
| `habit-apps-ranked.json` (repo root) | Public rating counts, averages, search ranks and market tiers per storefront (§1.6, Appendix G) | — |

## 1.2 Schema actually present

Every record carries 13 fields: `review_id` · `app_id` · `app_name` · `country` · `country_name` · `rating` · `title` · `body` · `author` · `date` (ISO-8601 UTC) · `vote_count` · `vote_sum` · `is_edited`.

- **Used for findings:** `review_id`, `country`, `rating`, `title`, `body`, `date`, `vote_count`, `vote_sum`, `is_edited`.
- **Present but unused:** `author` (pseudonymous; never aggregated), `app_id`, `app_name`, `country_name`.
- **`is_edited` is true for 186 records (0.90%).** Revision content is not available, only the flag.
- **`vote_count` > 0 on 323 records (1.57%).** The maximum is 63 (`5813993595`). Votes are cited where notable, never used as weights.
- **Body length:** median 19 characters, mean 34.9. That is short even by App Store standards and reflects the Chinese-language, prompt-driven corpus.

## 1.3 Coverage and reconciliation

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Lines in `reviews.jsonl` | 20,634 |
| Unique `review_id` | 20,634 (no duplicate IDs) |
| `manifest.json` `total_reviews` | 20,634 — match |
| Sum of `manifest.json` per-country counts | 20,634 — match |
| Rows across the 48 `by_country/*.jsonl` files | 20,634; union of IDs = 20,634 |
| IDs in country files but not in `reviews.jsonl` / vice versa | 0 / 0 |
| Per-country count mismatches vs manifest | 0 |
| `_state.json` complete flag | true for all 92 polled storefronts |
| Rating distribution vs manifest | exact match (5:13,415 · 4:3,278 · 3:1,498 · 2:570 · 1:1,873) |
| Mean rating vs manifest (4.25) | exact match (4.2500) |
| Records classified in `temp/52-review-classification.py` | **20,634 (100%)** |
| Classified IDs not present in the corpus | 0 |
| Corpus records with no theme assigned | 0 |
| Intra-review duplicate themes | 0 |
| Undefined theme codes used | 0 |
| Theme assignments total | 34,191 (1.66 per review) |
| Declared-but-unused codes | 1 (`SOC_GROUP_NEG`, kept in the taxonomy and reported as n = 0) |

Reproducible with `python3 temp/52-reconcile.py` and `python3 temp/52-validate.py`.

## 1.4 Deduplication rule

**No records were removed.** 171 distinct title+body pairs occur more than once, covering 953 records. Every one is a short generic phrase — `好`/`好` ×129, `不错`/`不错` ×74, `好用`/`好用` ×73, `很好`/`很好` ×46, `good`/`good` ×16 — from distinct `review_id`s, authors and dates. These are coincidental identical short reviews, not technical duplicates. All are retained and classified (almost all as `META_LOWINFO`). Every percentage uses **20,634** as the denominator.

## 1.5 Processing method

1. **Parse** all 20,634 records. Sort deterministically by date, then `review_id`, to assign a working index 1–20,634 (`temp/52-index.tsv`). Reconcile against `by_country/`, `manifest.json` and `_state.json`.
2. **Read every review individually, in the original language**, in chronological order. The corpus was split into 166 files of 125 reviews each (`temp/52-chunks/001–166.txt`) and read end to end, with no sampling, no keyword filtering and no skipped chunk. Chinese (simplified and traditional), English, Japanese and mixed-script reviews were read as written.
3. **Hand-assign themes** from a 123-code, 12-family taxonomy (Appendix B), built inductively from the corpus. One line was written per review (`temp/52-cls/NNN.txt`: `index CODE,CODE`). Assignment is non-exclusive.
4. **Resolve index → review_id** deterministically (`temp/52-build-classification.py`), cross-checking the index table against `reviews.jsonl`. This emits `temp/52-review-classification.py`.
5. **Validate programmatically** (`temp/52-validate.py`): zero unknown IDs, zero unassigned records, zero duplicate keys, zero intra-review duplicate themes, zero undefined codes.
6. **Aggregate** (`temp/52-aggregate.py`, `temp/52-extra.py`): global, per-star, per-storefront, market-group, year, era and month counts; composite unions; paid-segment lifts; burst days; duplicates.
7. **Text sub-cuts are always taken *inside* a hand-coded theme** — for example "auto-jump" wording within `AD_NEG`, or price figures within `PAY_*` reviews. They are labelled as text sub-cuts wherever they appear. No finding rests on a keyword search over the whole corpus.
8. **Re-read high-impact clusters** before writing about them: all 2025 `AD_NEG` window samples, every incident window in §8.4, every `META_CONTRA`, every `OUT_ADHD`, the `PAY_RESTORE`/`PAY_BILLING`/`PAY_REGRESS` samples, and every review quoted in this report (`temp/52-evidence-*.txt`, `temp/52-show.py`).

**No automated classifier was used.** The error risk is judgement error on ambiguous one-line reviews. The calls most likely to move a number are disclosed in Appendix D.

## 1.6 Limitations — read these before citing any figure

1. **No live store data.** No App Store page or developer site was fetched. **Every price, tier name, trial and feature description is reconstructed from review text** and carries reviewers' own errors. Contradictions are reported, not resolved.
2. **One external source is used:** this repository's own `habit-apps-ranked.json` snapshot (undated in-file). It supplies public rating counts, averages, search ranks and the `market_tier` classification (`rich` / `volume` / `other`), which §7.2 adopts as its high-spend definition.
3. **Selection bias:** writers are 3.67% of raters and skew 0.53★ lower. Reviews were also solicited, by a hard gate in 2017 and by Nth-launch prompts from 2020 (§1.7).
4. **One market dominates.** Findings labelled "global" are 95.32% mainland-China evidence. Non-Chinese markets are analysed separately and are small (§7).
5. **No version field and no developer responses** are in the data. Releases are dated from reviewer text. Several reviewers *mention* developer replies (`3823855755`, `11719901468`), but the replies themselves are not available.
6. **Short texts.** With a 19-character median body, many assignments rest on a single sentence. `META_LOWINFO` is applied generously; it is the largest theme at 23.07%.
7. **Currency and price figures are reviewer-reported** and span nine years of changes (§2.2). Where figures conflict, all are shown with dates.
8. **The app title's "ADHD" is not a corpus theme.** Only 6 reviews (0.03%, ignore) mention ADHD (§4.8). The listing's positioning and the reviewing population do not overlap.

## 1.7 Solicited reviews, bursts and review integrity

**Review-to-unlock (2017).** `META_UNLOCK` = 462 (2.24%, meaningful, mean 4.16). 427 are from 2017, 24 from 2018 and 11 from 2019–2025. 132 of the 462 name reminders as the gated feature. Oct–Dec 2017 holds 2,535 reviews (12.29% of the entire nine-year corpus), 415 of which are unlock reviews (16.4% of that window). Many are filler written to satisfy a length check:

- `1947016834` (5★, 25 Nov 2017), title *"要评价才能提醒"* (*EN:* "must review to get reminders"). The body repeats the title about twenty times.
- `1958402990` (5★, 29 Nov 2017), title *"来解锁"* (*EN:* "here to unlock"). The body is a random string of characters.
- `1959643783` (5★, 30 Nov 2017): *"要写够多少字啊，不是想要自动提醒就不想来写这个评论…总算知道为什么评论里老有复制粘贴其他东西的了"* — *EN:* "how many characters do I need… I wouldn't write this if I didn't want reminders… now I know why reviews are full of pasted text."
- `1901055265` (5★, 6 Nov 2017) repeats *"能不能不要逼人写评价啊"* (*EN:* "please stop forcing people to write reviews") dozens of times — at five stars.
- `2524800702` (1★, May 2018) names the effect: *"很多人给五星的原因是因为，之前给了好评才可以继续使用这个软件"* — *EN:* "many gave five stars because a good review was required to keep using the app."

**Consequences:**
- The 2017 year mean (4.61) is the highest of any full year.
- 2017 holds 48.6% `META_LOWINFO` and 20.3% `META_PREUSE` (542 of all 717 pre-use reviews).
- All 15 of the busiest days in the corpus fall between 5 Nov and 13 Dec 2017 (79, 70, 69, 63, 63… reviews/day across 3,205 distinct review days).

2017 figures are shown in every trend table but are **not used as a baseline for "decline"** (§8.1).

**Nth-launch prompts (2020–2026).** 40 reviews (text census over the full corpus, mean 4.50) mention being prompted — *"第500次打开"* (`11090257717`, `11216871410`, `11350173560`), *"第800次打开"* (`11065176175`), *"第3000次打开"* (`11285961475`) — or complain about the prompt: `6682921169` (3★, 2020) *"刚下载还没用就一直提示让过来评论"* (*EN:* "just downloaded, haven't used it, and it keeps asking me to review"); `13351689320` (3★, 2025) *"8块钱去了广告 死活让我来评价"* (*EN:* "paid 8 yuan to remove ads and it still insists I review").

**Fake-review allegations.** `META_FAKE` = 37 (0.18%, weak, mean 2.27). These are mostly 1★ reviewers who cannot reconcile the high average with their experience (`12841963125` 2025: *"这么高评分估计是买的"*, *EN:* "such a high score must be bought"; `3761234905` us 2019). No evidence of purchased reviews was found beyond the disclosed 2017 gate.

**Contradictions.** 73 (0.35%) — §5.6 and Appendix E.

# PART 2 — PRODUCT AND MONETIZATION MODEL (review-derived)

## 2.1 What the product is, per reviewers

A **habit check-in app** with a hand-drawn, pastel "小清新" (fresh, light) style. Nine years of releases added to-dos, notes, rewards, focus timing and statistics. Reviewers describe these surfaces:

| Surface | Review-derived description | Theme evidence | Representative IDs |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Habit check-in (日常)** | Tap an icon to complete a habit; habits grouped by time of day (起床 / 晨间 / 中午 / 晚间 "scenes"); daily, weekly and custom frequencies | `CORE_CHECK` 217 · `CORE_SEGMENT` 159 · `CORE_FREQ` 299 | `2239007655` `3254531371` `10229830471` |
| **Habit icons & styles** | Illustrated icon library, colour palettes, themes/skins, fonts; later custom uploaded images | `DES_ICON_LIKE` 321 · `DES_ICON_WANT` 561 · `DES_THEME` 343 | `5234243491` `13663058300` `14449455617` |
| **Daily card (卡片 / 卡包)** | Completing the day's habits yields a quote card, saved to a card wallet | `CARD_GOOD` 106 · `CARD_BUG` 193 · `CARD_WANT` 154 | `2584511973` `2114506602` `7503066855` |
| **Check-in notes (打卡日志 / 碎碎念)** | A note per check-in; later a standalone notes stream; "on this day in past years" (往年今日); AI note titles (2026) | `JRNL_GOOD` 234 · `JRNL_WANT` 668 | `6984394901` `12696434160` `13930545782` |
| **Reminders (提醒 / 整点报时)** | Per-habit reminders; hourly chime; "strong reminder" | `REM_GOOD` 185 · `REM_FAIL` 279 · `REM_WANT` 588 | `4607325416` `5553105088` `8593368940` |
| **Rewards (光芒值 / 光芒心愿)** | Points per check-in, exchanged for self-defined wishes; "habit balls" collection (2026) | `STAT_REWARD` 312 · `STAT_PENALTY` 21 | `11663316873` `13992537486` `13591116003` |
| **Statistics** | Weekly/monthly calendars, timeline of the day, year statistics (moved to VIP Dec 2025) | `STAT_GOOD` 155 · `STAT_WANT` 478 | `5813993595` `13559154241` `13983550843` |

## 2.3 Free / paid / trial / unclear classification

| Capability | Status per reviews | Confidence | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Download, habit check-in, basic statistics | **Free** | High | universal |
| Number of habits | **Free up to a quota** — most often stated as 5 (2018–2024); 3, 4, 6, 8 and 10 also reported; from 2025 the quota **grows with check-ins** | High (existence), medium (number) | §0.2 |
| Reminders | **Gated behind a written review in 2017**; free afterwards | High | `1947016834` `1939187899` |
| Premium icons, themes/skins, some colours | **Paid** (and themes sold separately in 2018) | High | `2459857576` `2570484742` `6714504989` |
| Backup / restore from iCloud after reinstall | **Paid in several builds** — reviewers asked to buy membership to restore their own data | Medium-high (32 reviews) | `6494333470` `11779820068` |
| Year statistics | **Free until Dec 2025, then VIP** | High (15 reviews since Nov 2025) | `13501470470` `13559154241` `13530928663` |
| Ad-free | **Paid (¥8 lifetime) from ~Oct 2025**; earlier builds had splash ads that membership removed inconsistently | High | `13284916834` `4189381643` `6130073882` |
| Focus timer basics | **Free**; some timing modes (on-the-hour count, blocking) prompt for membership | Medium | `14466033004` `14501891567` |
| Trial | **3-day trial** appears in 2026 onboarding; earlier trials 7 days in some reviews | Medium | `13986964200` `14206066896` `14053361336` |
| Social / community | **Does not exist**, and payers ask that it never will | High | `SOC_NOSOCIAL` 120 |
| Apple Watch, Mac (full), Android parity | **Not available / broken** | High | `PLAT_WATCH` 256 · `PLAT_MAC` 37 |

**Unclear from reviews:** whether the habit quota differs by cohort or A/B test (reviewers in the same month report different caps); whether iCloud restore is ever free in current builds; whether Android and iOS memberships have ever been unified (2018–2026 reviewers say no).

## 2.4 One structural observation about the model

The monetization history is a sequence of **re-scopings of what was already owned**:
- one-time unlock → tiered unlock → subscription (2020);
- free themes for premium members → paid themes → themes free again (a 2018 buyer got a refund, `2692072328`);
- free year statistics → VIP (2025);
- ad-free for everyone → ad-free for ¥8 (2025).

Each re-scoping generated its own complaint wave, and `PAY_REGRESS` (existing entitlement reduced) = 75 (0.36%, weak, **mean 2.15**) is the lowest-mean price theme after `PAY_SCAM` and `PAY_REFUND`. Where old entitlements *were* honoured, reviewers wrote some of the warmest reviews in the corpus (`8082408412`, `9563598738`, `11466372895`). **Honouring old purchases costs almost nothing and is the single strongest trust signal in these reviews.**

## 2.5 Positioning versus the reviewing population

The listing subtitle names **ADHD** and **Focus**. The reviewers name **cute, clean, simple, self-discipline** and **no social features**. `OUT_ADHD` = 6 (0.03%). `FOCUS` = 390 (1.89%), rising to 5.5% of 2026 reviews — mostly requests and complaints about the new focus page (§4.7). The reviewing population is a Chinese self-discipline and planner audience. Any ADHD-specific roadmap would be built on the listing's positioning, not on this corpus.

## 3.3 Prioritised negative themes

### N1 — Ads — `AD_NEG`, 885 (4.29%), very strong, mean 2.46 · cn×864 · 2018-12 → 2026-09
Two waves: splash and cross-promotion ads in 2019–2021 (206 reviews), and the June 2025 in-flow ads (575 in 2025). The mechanics (auto-jump, motion triggers, broken close) are the complaint, not the existence of ads — §0.1. Related: `AD_CROSSPROMO` 26 (0.13%, weak) — forced Weibo-follow and developer-promotion pop-ups that couldn't be dismissed (`3926888539`, `5674638517`, 2019–2021). IDs: `12831040911` `12803944732` `13362003467` `12795677855` `12844224345` `12914673906` `4607325416` `7038818912`.

### N2 — Free habit quota — `PAY_CAP5`, 888 (4.30%), very strong, mean 2.96 · 2017-09 → 2026-08
The first paywall any user meets. Declining since 2020 and nearly gone in 2026 once the quota started growing with use — §0.2. IDs: `2001609740` `5519779697` `5560993303` `3853033716` `8759088131` `12892816707` `13289981450`.

### N3 — General paywall — `PAY_WALL`, 715 (3.47%), very strong, mean 2.62
"Everything costs money": themes, backgrounds, backup, and later year statistics and some focus modes. It peaked in 2018 (7.1%) and returned in December 2025 (year statistics) and 2026 (mandatory trial selection at onboarding). IDs: `2524800702` `5662173619` `13559154241` `13501470470` `14507944819` `14501891567` `14031908801`.

### N4 — Reliability failure union — 2,608 (12.64%), high-priority, mean 3.49
- `BUG_FEATURE` 647 (3.14%) — a named feature broken.
- `BUG_UPDATE` 524 (2.54%) — an update caused it.
- `PLAT_WIDGET_BUG` 454 (2.20%).
- `BUG_CRASH` 412 (2.00%).
- `REM_FAIL` 279 (1.35%).
- `DATA_LOSS` 229 (1.11%).
- `CARD_BUG` 193 (0.94%) — 93.3% of these in 2018–2021.
- `BUG_DISPLAY` 181 (0.88%).
- `DATA_SYNC_FAIL` 151 (0.73%).
- `BUG_LAG` 132 (0.64%).

Release-clustered — §0.5, §8.4.

### N5 — Entitlement broken — 573 (2.78%), meaningful, mean 2.96
- `PAY_BILLING` 261 (1.26%, mean 3.51) — 83.5% of these in 2018–2020: purchases that spin forever, double charges, a price shown as ¥12 but charged ¥31, no Alipay/WeChat Pay. IDs: `1953868037` `2404783757` `2415453515` `5560444593`.
- `PAY_RESTORE` 190 (0.92%, mean 2.61) — §0.4.
- `PAY_REGRESS` 75 (0.36%, mean 2.15) — §2.4.
- `PAY_PRICE_RISE` 42 (0.20%).
- `PAY_REFUND` 32 (0.16%, mean 1.91).

A reviewer-reported carrier-billing incident (`13342556684`, 1★, Nov 2025) describes an SMS login that subscribed the user to ¥55/month of China Mobile services. It is a single report, flagged because it is a potential legal and billing exposure, not a pattern.

### N6 — Interface regression — 824 (3.99%), very strong, mean 3.58
§0.6. `DES_DENSE` 427 (2.07%) is persistent (1.4–3.9% every year); `DES_REDESIGN` 372 (1.80%) is event-driven.

### N7 — Money-grab accusations — `PAY_SCAM`, 183 (0.89%), emerging, mean **1.36**
158 of the 183 are 1★ (86.3%) — the most rating-concentrated theme in the corpus. The trigger is almost always a re-scoping (§2.4) or an unexpected charge, rarely the price level itself. IDs: `6014282876` `7527160505` `8372670716` `11012729767` `12834474035` `13599050555`.

### N8 — Support silence — `SUP_BAD`, 184 (0.89%), emerging, mean 2.33
Rises with each crash wave (2018: 48; 2024: 27; 2025: 23). Among payers it has a 4.53× lift and a 1.92 mean (§0.3). Reviewers report email, WeChat, Weibo and Xiaohongshu channels going unanswered. IDs: `5718060639` `7678755936` `9932746241` `12099235782` `12506637899` `13185604830` `14460646052`.

### N9 — International users can't read the app — `LOC_UNTRANS` 153 (0.74%) + `LOC_WANT` 99 (0.48%) + `LOC_ENGBAD` 11
Small globally; the top theme in every eligible non-mainland storefront — §0.7, §7.

### N10 — Privacy and permissions — `DATA_PRIVACY`, 65 (0.32%), weak, mean 3.48
Location access (`11313989030`; `9500642269` "still using location after uninstall"), a dead privacy-policy link (`6897719071`, nz), a passcode lock that an ad dismissal bypasses (`13404013818`, 2025), and forced iCloud or Apple-ID binding (`14366400588`, `14389575364`). Individually weak, but the passcode bypass and location claims are security-relevant and are recorded despite the band.

## 3.4 Prioritised positive themes

### P1 — Clean and simple — `DES_CLEAN`, 1,716 (8.32%), high-priority, mean 4.84
The #1 substantive theme. It is stable across nine years (4.2–13.6% of each year) and recovered to 9–11% in 2024–2026. IDs: `2239007655` `5234243491` `8292363946` `12806346802` `14466033004`.

### P2 — Cute art style — `DES_CUTE`, 1,431 (6.94%), high-priority, mean 4.77
Dominant at launch (18.5% of 2017), declining steadily to 2.9% in 2026 while `DES_CLEAN` held. The app is increasingly praised for calm rather than cuteness. In non-mainland storefronts cuteness is still the lead praise (us 20.56%, ca 14.75%, au 13.21%, tw 12.94%). IDs: `1799881579` `3300136517` `13445617661` `14053361336`.

### P3 — Reported outcomes — 1,340 (6.49%), high-priority, mean 4.88
`OUT_DISCIPLINE` 761 (3.69%, mean 4.90), `OUT_FITNESS` 190, `OUT_LIFE` 168, `OUT_STUDY` 115, `OUT_PROCRAST` 107, `OUT_MENTAL` 57, `OUT_ADHD` 6. IDs: `5743585438` `11919980065` `13578778405` `13662299946` `13925038009` `14460751570`.

### P4 — Long-tenure users and developer trust — `USER_LONGTERM` 705 (3.42%) · `DEV_TRUST` 213 (1.03%, mean 4.93) · `SUP_GOOD` 148 (0.72%, mean 4.93)
Fast fixes are named specifically: a purchase crash fixed the next day (`2838663501`, 2018), a bug fixed a day after email (`5913842481`, 2020), a feature request shipped within days (`11719901468`, 2024) and within a month (`13403164932`, 2025). Honoured lifetime memberships: `8082408412` `9563598738`.

### P5 — Motivation mechanics — `STAT_REWARD` 312 (1.51%, mean 4.65) · `CARD_GOOD` 106 (0.51%, mean 4.83) · `STAT_GOOD` 155 (0.75%, mean 4.90) · `DES_ANIM` 115 (0.56%, mean 4.66)
Rewards exchanged for self-set wishes, the check-in sound ("咔嚓声"), and the daily quote card. IDs: `11663316873` `13992537486` `14330209556` `2584511973`.

### P6 — No social layer, no noise — `SOC_NOSOCIAL` 120 (0.58%, mean 4.85) · `AD_NONE_PRAISE` 172 (0.83%, mean 4.90)
`AD_NONE_PRAISE` *rose* in 2024–2026 (1.3–1.7% of reviews), because paying members and pre-ad-era builds were compared explicitly with the new ad experience. IDs: `1799881579` `3020069241` `11772429963` `12727553179` `14403408295`.

### P7 — Reminders that work — `REM_GOOD`, 185 (0.90%), emerging, mean 4.88
Frequently for medication or life admin: `13229374881` (medication), `13812563564` (IVF medication schedule).

## 3.7 What is *not* a finding

- **Trial complaints** (`PAY_TRIAL` 71, 0.34%) are weak until 2026 and are concentrated in the new onboarding — watch, don't act on the level yet (§8.5).

- **ADHD** (6 reviews) — see §2.5.

# PART 4 — WHAT ACTIVE USERS SAY ABOUT THE PRODUCT

This part excludes monetization (Part 6) and reads the feature-level themes from people who clearly use the app.

## 4.1 The check-in loop: fast is the feature

`CORE_CHECK` = 217 (1.05%, mean 4.87). Reviewers describe one tap, a sound, the icon lighting up. Every change that added a step was reviewed negatively within days:
- the **June 2021 status sheet** (§0.6);
- the removal of **"tap again to undo"** (`10956751942`, 2024: *"以前是再点一下就可以取消打卡了，现在…只能选打卡失败"*, *EN:* "you used to tap again to cancel; now you can only choose 'failed'");
- the **2026 "habit ball" collection** that couldn't be hidden (`13991192760`, `14001497640`);
- **multi-check habits** that force a detail sheet even with one-tap enabled (`14460646052`).

## 4.2 Motivation: rewards and cards beat streaks

- **Rewards:** `STAT_REWARD` 312 (1.51%, mean 4.65).
- **Cards:** `CARD_GOOD` 106 (0.51%, mean 4.83) against `CARD_BUG` 193 (0.94%, mean 3.96) and `CARD_WANT` 154 (0.75%).
- **Streaks:** `STAT_STREAK` 106 (0.51%, mean 4.00).

The reward shop (points exchanged for self-set wishes) is praised as a way to delay spending (`13992537486` asks for separate point currencies per habit type; `14002570586` uses it to curb impulse buying). The daily card was a launch-era hook. Its bugs (blank cards, can't claim, duplicate images) were 93.3% concentrated in 2018–2021, and complaints stopped once the card became manual (`6816187446`, 2021, *"每天的卡片还要自己手动去领？"*, *EN:* "now I have to claim each day's card by hand?").

## 4.3 Scheduling mechanics that don't fit real routines

- `CORE_FREQ` 299 (1.45%)
- `CORE_MULTI` 237 (1.15%)
- `CORE_RETRO` 218 (1.06%)
- `CORE_ORDER` 151 (0.73%)
- `CORE_SEGMENT` 159 (0.77%, mean 3.99)
- `CORE_ARCHIVE` 133 (0.64%)

The consistent pattern is that **reality is messier than a daily grid**:
- weekly-N habits spoil a "100% day" (`8267555469`);
- night owls' check-ins after midnight land on the next day (`3867825890`, `14510307751`);
- one habit needs two check-ins (`9824409111`, `14482764227`);
- to-dos lose their custom order (`14453965506`, `14435125339`).

## 4.4 Reminders: the reason people install, and a top paid-user failure

| Theme | n | % | Mean ★ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `REM_GOOD` | 185 | 0.90% | 4.88 |
| `REM_FAIL` | 279 | 1.35% | 3.45 |
| `REM_WANT` | 588 | 2.85% | 4.36 |
| `REM_ANNOY` | 155 | 0.75% | 3.26 |

Among payers, `REM_FAIL` has a 3.62× lift (63 of 1,286) — reminders were the gated feature in 2017, so reviewers bought or reviewed *for* them. Failures:
- silent mode kills the sound (`5553105088`);
- reminders keep firing after the habit is done (`3720806853`, 23 votes; `3942069540`);
- archived habits still remind (`14196747453`);
- changed reminder sounds revert (`10789570246`);
- notifications stop entirely (`8593368940`, paid).

## 4.5 Notes and journaling: the biggest single request

`JRNL_GOOD` = 234 (1.13%, mean 4.85) against `JRNL_WANT` = 668 (3.24%, very strong). Many users treat 小日常 as a micro-diary (`14034097323`; "往年今日" praise `13948803433`). The asks, in order of frequency seen while reading:
1. **photos in check-in logs and notes** (`2002976675` 2017 → `12696434160` 2025: *"能不能加入打卡的照片！！真的很想要照片！！！"*, *EN:* "please add photos to check-ins!! I really want photos!!!");
2. browsing all logs beyond the current month (`14409706316`);
3. autosave so an interrupted note isn't lost (`9989639645`, `13861341315`);
4. no forced titles and no AI titles (`13930545782`, `14508025525`).

## 4.6 Platforms: widgets, iPad, Watch, Mac, Android

| Theme | n | % | Band | Mean ★ | Peak |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---|
| `PLAT_WIDGET_BUG` | 454 | 2.20% | Meaningful | 3.91 | 2020–2021 (62.8% of all) |
| `PLAT_IPAD` | 380 | 1.84% | Meaningful | 4.09 | 2018–2020 (63.7% of all) |
| `PLAT_WATCH` | 256 | 1.24% | Meaningful | 4.52 | persistent, 2019–2020 peak |
| `PLAT_WIDGET_WANT` | 240 | 1.16% | Meaningful | 4.48 | persistent |
| `PLAT_ANDROID` | 195 | 0.95% | Emerging | 3.53 | persistent |
| `PLAT_OS` | 49 | 0.24% | Weak | 3.55 | iOS version floor / old devices |
| `PLAT_MAC` | 37 | 0.18% | Weak | 3.81 | 2021–2025 (WeChat binding) |

**Widgets carry more emotional weight than their count suggests.** `5169380786` (at storefront, 5★, 2019): *"Maybe the most important features of ShineDay are its widgets. Being able to 'check off' completed habits without opening the app…"*. When iOS 14 removed that in October 2020, 55 widget-bug reviews arrived in one month. The same fragility recurs in 2024 (`11984523524`: *"每次升级后…变来变去"*, *EN:* "changes every update"), in 2026 (`14508345550`: widget check-in removed again), and on iOS 26 with Clear/Tinted home screens (`14329669709`: widget renders blank).

## 4.7 Scope creep: to-dos, focus and AI

- `CORE_TODO` 307 (1.49%) rose to 3.0% of 2024 reviews when 小事 (to-dos) shipped.
- `FOCUS` 390 rose to 5.5% of 2026 reviews.

Users accept these features but consistently rank them *below* check-in speed:
- `14103541349` (4★, 2026) lays out a careful to-do and timer spec;
- `14398335606` (5★, Aug 2026): *"请产品经理务必不要瞎加功能，请一定克制克制"* (*EN:* "product manager, please don't add features blindly — restraint, restraint");
- `13842773106` (3★, 2026): the focus app-block list works backwards, allowing only the blocked apps.

The August 2026 focus page redesign (§0.6) is the latest instance.

## 4.8 ADHD and neurodivergence — 6 reviews (0.03%, ignore)

`3254531371` (gb, 5★, 2018, 2 votes: breaking "get ready" into steps helps with likely ADHD), `7621851935` (ca, 5★, 2021), `9740237093` (cn, 5★, 2023, *"adhd，希望用下去"*), `12499012234` (cn, 4★, 2025, *"adhd好评"*), `12545714069` (gb, 5★, 2025), `13137415583` (cn, 5★, 2025, *"很适合adha使用"*). All positive (mean 4.83). They are too few to support any product claim, and are recorded because the listing uses ADHD in its name (§2.5).

## 5.1 Five stars (n = 13,415, 65.01%)

**30.8% of 5★ reviews (4,131) carry no product content** (`META_LOWINFO`), plus 445 pre-use reviews and 233 review-to-unlock reviews. Substantive 5★ praise is:
- simplicity (`DES_CLEAN` 11.1%) and cuteness (`DES_CUTE` 8.7%);
- purchase satisfaction (`PAY_BOUGHT` 6.1%);
- outcomes (`OUT_DISCIPLINE` 5.2%);
- tenure (`USER_LONGTERM` 4.4%).

5★ reviews are also where **requests** live: `JRNL_WANT` 387, `DES_ICON_WANT` 356, `REM_WANT` 323 and `STAT_WANT` 267 are all majority-5★. A 5★ review here is often "I love it, please add X". Differentiator signal: `DEV_TRUST` (204 of 213 are 5★) and `META_RECOMMEND` (277 of 289).

## 5.2 Four stars (n = 3,278, 15.89%)

The *request* band: `REM_WANT` 5.7%, `JRNL_WANT` 5.6%, `STAT_WANT` 4.7%, `DES_ICON_WANT` 4.5%. It is also where the quota bites without anger (`PAY_CAP5` 5.5%): "love it, wish more habits were free" (`3300136517`, `5818585169`). 4★ reviewers name the one thing withheld from 5★ — language (`10229830471`), or ads added recently (`12806854675`).

## 5.3 Three stars (n = 1,498, 7.26%)

Monetization and reliability without contempt: `PAY_CAP5` 10.3%, `AD_NEG` 9.3%, `BUG_FEATURE` 6.7%, `BUG_UPDATE` 5.5%, `BUG_CRASH` 4.6%, `PLAT_WIDGET_BUG` 4.3%. A typical 3★ is a paying user listing numbered bugs (`5170598820`, `11602790209`, `13804721782`).

## 5.4 Two stars (n = 570, 2.76%)

`AD_NEG` 18.1%, `PAY_CAP5` 17.2%, `PAY_WALL` 13.0%. The 2★ reviewer usually still uses the app and is warning others (`12803944732`: *"用了好多年…再这样下去，我真的想重新换个打卡的app了"*, *EN:* "used it for years… if this continues I'll really switch apps").

## 5.5 One star (n = 1,873, 9.08%)

`AD_NEG` 20.4% (383), `PAY_WALL` 15.9%, `PAY_CAP5` 13.7%, `PAY_BOUGHT` 9.0% (168 paid reviewers), `PAY_SCAM` 8.4%, `BUG_UPDATE` 7.0%, `BUG_CRASH` 6.0%, `SUP_BAD` 5.0%, `DATA_LOSS` 4.5%, `PAY_RESTORE` 4.2%.

**Two drivers of churn are visible in 1★ reviews:**
1. **Moral objection to monetization** — `PAY_SCAM`, 86.3% of which is 1★.
2. **Loss of something already invested** — data, streak or a paid entitlement.

The second group are long-tenure users. `USER_LONGTERM` has 34 1★ reviews, e.g. `11776198730` (*"白瞎用了整整五年"*, *EN:* "five whole years wasted"), and `DATA_LOSS` is 37.1% 1★.

## 5.6 Reviews contradicting their own rating — `META_CONTRA`, 73 (0.35%, weak)

35 are 5★, 24 are 1★, 7 are 2★, 4 are 4★ and 3 are 3★. They fall into four types:

| Type | Example |
|---|---|
| 5★ given to unlock or to be seen, text negative | `1932545403` (5★ *"就很垃圾 要评价才能解锁"*, *EN:* "it's trash, have to review to unlock"); `13048313896` (5★ *"五星让大家看到，这个软件广告多的要死"*, *EN:* "five stars so everyone sees: this app has tons of ads") |
| 1★ given to praise | `12594769019` (1★ *"小巧，好用！还是免费的，点赞！"*, *EN:* "small, handy, free — thumbs up"); `7461051480` (1★ because *"很多人喜欢看差评"*, *EN:* "people read bad reviews") |
| Rating capped for a single missing thing | `5222510620` (ca, 1★ — would be 4–5★ with full English); `4887783468` (au, 3★ with an entirely positive text) |
| Joke / irony | `11997804351` (1★ *"给了六星好评，溢出一颗"*, *EN:* "six stars, one overflowed") |

The full list is in Appendix E. The negative-text 5★ reviews (35) and positive-text 1★ reviews (24) pull in opposite directions. At 0.35% of the corpus they cannot move a headline figure, and they are kept in every count.

## 5.7 Theme direction is not fixed by rating

- `PAY_CAP5` has 199 five-star reviews ("the quota is fine, the app is lovely").
- `AD_NEG` has 132 five-star reviews.
- `PAY_BOUGHT` has 168 one-star reviews.

Star rating alone is therefore not used anywhere in this report as a proxy for feature preference.

# PART 6 — PAID-USER AND UPGRADE ANALYSIS

**Evidence tiers.**
- **Direct:** `PAY_BOUGHT` = 1,286 first-person statements of buying, subscribing or being a member (6.23%).
- **Lifetime subset:** `PAY_BOUGHT` ∩ `PAY_LIFETIME` = 199.
- **Indirect interest:** `PAY_LIFETIME` without a purchase statement = 233 (asking for, praising or mourning a lifetime option; mean 3.64).
- **No conversion rate is claimed**; written reviewers are not a purchase funnel.

## 6.2 What triggers a purchase (in reviewers' own words)

1. **The look, within days of install.** "Downloaded, five minutes later bought premium" (`2878274954`); "third day, bought 大太阳" (`5743585438`); "within 24 hrs of the trial I bought lifetime" (`14053361336`, us). `DES_CLEAN` appears in 118 payer reviews and `DES_CUTE` in 88.
2. **Lifting the habit quota**, stated or implied. Explicit in 17 payer reviews (`5562288248`: *"18买断确实不贵 3个习惯是在太少…所以没思考就买了"*, *EN:* "¥18 lifetime isn't expensive; 3 habits is too few, so I bought without thinking").
3. **Icons and themes** — 161 payers (4.50 mean) mention them; they are both a reason to buy and the top payer request.
4. **Supporting an indie developer.** `DEV_TRUST` ∩ paid = 52 (mean 4.98). `5234243491` (54 votes): *"比一杯星巴克都还低的价钱，换来每天美好的心情绝对值得"* (*EN:* "less than a Starbucks for a good mood every day — absolutely worth it"); `12398631654` bought "so the app can keep running".
5. **One-time rather than subscription.** `PAY_SUB_NEG` payers and non-payers alike prefer lifetime (`3291064932`, us: *"one time purchase instead of a subscription"*; `8200081272`, gb).
6. **Removing ads (2025–26).** The ¥8 SKU: `13284916834`, `14100445684`.

`14450688542` (tw, 1★, Aug 2026) is the clearest current billing case: bought the lifetime unlock for NT$390 during a trial, was then charged NT$220 for the annual plan, and emails to support bounced.

## 6.5 Refunds — `PAY_REFUND`, 32 (0.16%, weak, mean 1.91)

Triggers:
- redesign removing a used feature (`12062367782`, ¥68, Dec 2024);
- crash plus "give me my money back" (`13869205023`, `4953271455`);
- a charge after deleting the app (`8372670716`);
- a new buyer overwhelmed by friction on day one (`14460646052`);
- a 2018 refund granted after themes became free for premium members (`2692072328`).

## 6.6 Signals that would change a paying user's mind

From the payer reviews read, in order of how often they recur:
1. membership and data that follow the account to any device;
2. no ads for anyone who has paid anything;
3. keep one-tap check-in and ship redesigns as optional;
4. a reply when something breaks;
5. more icons and themes;
6. photos in logs;
7. an Apple Watch app.

None of these is a price cut. Payers overwhelmingly find the price fair (`PAY_PRICE_OK` lift 4.58).

## 7.2 Market groups — defined, not assumed

**High-spend markets.** Membership comes from the `market_tier = "rich"` label in `habit-apps-ranked.json` (the repository's own classification). 19 storefronts in this corpus carry it: cn, us, tw, hk, au, sg, jp, de, fr, nz, nl, it, se, sa, es, ae, at, no, dk. Together they hold 20,453 reviews (mean 4.25). Because cn dominates, the group is also shown **excluding cn: 784 reviews, mean 4.19**. Top themes (segment rates of 784):
- `DES_CUTE` 14.2%
- `META_LOWINFO` 12.8%
- **`LOC_UNTRANS` 12.4%**
- `DES_CLEAN` 11.0%
- **`LOC_WANT` 8.8%**
- `PAY_BOUGHT` 7.5%
- `USER_LONGTERM` 5.0%
- `DES_PRETTY` 4.5%
- `PAY_PRICE_OK` 4.1%
- `PAY_LIFETIME` 3.6%

**Monetization reads differently here:** price is praised (`PAY_PRICE_OK`), not resisted, and ads barely appear. `AD_NEG` outside cn totals 21 reviews across all 47 non-cn storefronts.

**High-review-volume markets.** No download data is available, so review volume is used as a disclosed proxy:
- **(a)** storefronts with ≥50 written reviews: cn, us, tw, hk, ca, au — 20,390 reviews, 98.82% of the corpus;
- **(b)** by public rating count in the snapshot: cn 550,321 · us 3,259 · tw 2,509 · hk 2,093 · au 651 · jp 529 · my 482.

The two lists agree except that ca and gb are not ranked in the snapshot and jp/my have few written reviews. The snapshot's `volume` tier (15 emerging-market storefronts) holds only 60 reviews (mean 4.40), with `LOC_UNTRANS` in 20 of them (33.3%) — [limited evidence], but the same direction as every other non-Chinese group.

- **Canada:** `LOC_UNTRANS` 14 (22.95%), `DES_CUTE` 9 (14.75%), `PAY_PRICE_OK` 6 (9.84%), `PAY_CAP5` 5 (8.20%), `PLAT_WIDGET_BUG` 4 (6.56%). Not ranked in the snapshot (no public figure).
- **Australia:** `LOC_UNTRANS` 11 (20.75%), `DES_CUTE` 7 (13.21%), `PLAT_WIDGET_BUG` 4 (7.55%) and `JRNL_WANT` 4 (7.55%). Written mean 4.04 is the lowest of the six eligible storefronts, against a 4.71 public average.
- Both storefronts: **zero `AD_NEG`, zero `META_UNLOCK`**. At n ≈ 50–60, every theme with 3+ reviews clears the "very strong" band. Read these tables for direction, and read Part 10 for the individual reviews.

**The gap is uniform (≈ −0.5★).** Localisation complaints in English-speaking storefronts do not show up as a deeper public-rating penalty. The ad wave is not visible in the public average either — the snapshot is undated, and 562,951 ratings absorb a 1,562-review window.

## 7.9 Localisation and language

- **Scripts in the corpus:** Chinese 19,858 (96.24%); Latin script, mostly English, 731 (3.54%); no letters (emoji/digits) 40; Japanese 5. Of the 731 Latin-script reviews, 294 come from the cn storefront (English-speaking users with a mainland Apple ID). Full list in Appendix F.
- **`LOC_UNTRANS` by year:** 17 (2018), 26, 38, 28, 17, 4, 8, 5, 10 (2026). It peaked in 2020 and has **not** been fixed — it persists in 2025–2026 (`13629767047` de; `13971540834` dk: "some pages and headings have to be translated from Chinese"; `14514304514` us).
- **Mixed-language UI** is reported even by Chinese-reading users on English systems (`11414179245`: asks for an in-app language setting independent of iOS).

## 7.10 What is not supported by country data

- No claim is made that any non-Chinese market is more or less *price-sensitive* in general. `PAY_PRICE_OK` is higher outside cn, but on n < 300 per storefront and with different price points.
- No cultural generalisation is drawn about why mainland users write shorter reviews. Prompt-driven and unlock-driven solicitation (§1.7) is a sufficient mechanical explanation.

# PART 8 — TIME-TREND ANALYSIS

## 8.1 Method

- **Periods:** calendar years (2026 partial). Six *eras* are defined only for readability; their boundaries are years, not inferred release dates.
- **Monthly and incident analysis:** every month (110) is profiled on ten indicator codes (month table in §8.4). An **incident window** is a month where one indicator reaches ≥ 10 reviews and clearly stands out against adjacent months in that table. Each window was re-read (`temp/52-evidence-windows.txt`).
- **Baseline caution:** 2017 is distorted by review-to-unlock (§1.7). "Decline since launch" comparisons start from 2018.
- **What counts as a trend:** a direction held for ≥ 2 consecutive years with ≥ 50 reviews per year in the theme, or a single incident window explicitly labelled as such.

- `JRNL_WANT` ~5% (2018–2021) → ~2% (2022–2026).

**Persistent:** `DES_CLEAN` (4–14% every year); `DES_DENSE` (1.4–3.9% every year); `DATA_LOSS` (0.4–1.8% every year); `LOC_UNTRANS` (every year since 2018); `PLAT_WATCH` (0.7–2.6% every year since 2019).

## 8.5 What the trend data does *not* support

- **Whether ads were rolled back.** `AD_NEG` fell from 60–63/month (Oct–Nov 2025) to 4–14/month (Feb–Jul 2026), but review volume also fell (from ~250 to ~140/month). Complainants may have churned, rather than ads receding. The 2026 reviews still describe ads (`14484909185`, Aug 2026: an ad on every tab, each with a differently placed close button).
- **Causal effect of the quota growing with use.** `PAY_CAP5` declined steadily *before* 2025 as well (5.3% → 3.3% from 2021 to 2024). The 2025 mechanic is consistent with the decline but not proven to cause it.
- **Onboarding trial effects (2026).** Only a few reviews describe the mandatory trial selection (`13986964200` `14206066896` `14389575364`) — too few and too recent for a trend.
- **AI features.** AI note titles appear in a small number of 2026 reviews, all negative (`13930545782`, `13965180848`, `14508025525`, `13723729804`), with no before/after comparison possible.

## 8.6 Persistent themes — unchanged for nine years

`DES_CLEAN` praise, `DES_DENSE` fear, `PLAT_WATCH` requests, `LOC_UNTRANS`, `DATA_LOSS`, and the request for photos in notes. None of these moved across releases, price changes or redesigns.

# PART 9 — PRODUCT IMPLICATIONS

Each item names the finding it rests on. **F** = immediate fixes (defects and harm); **M** = monetization changes to test; **R** = product and retention work; **Q** = research questions this corpus cannot answer.

## 9.1 Immediate fixes

| # | Fix | Why (finding) | Success signal in future reviews |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | **Remove motion-triggered and auto-jump ad formats; make every close control close; no ad after a check-in** | §0.1: 546 ad complaints in six months; 107 auto-jump, 88 broken-close and 33 motion-trigger reports; lowest month in nine years | `AD_NEG` share below the 2020–21 level (≤3%) |
| F2 | **No ads for any paying member, including legacy lifetime and ¥8 ad-free buyers**; verify entitlement before rendering the first ad | §0.1 / §6.4: 40 paying reviewers reported ads (2019–2026) | Zero `AD_NEG` ∩ `PAY_BOUGHT` |
| F3 | **Never gate restoring a user's own backup behind membership** | §0.3: 32 reviews; payer data-loss mean 1.73 | `DATA_LOSS` ∩ `PAY_*` → 0 |
| F4 | **Account-bound restore that works across reinstall, iPad, Mac and Android** (including QQ-era Android buyers); fix Mac WeChat binding | §0.4: `PAY_RESTORE` 190, Android ∩ tier/restore 49, Mac binding 12 since 2021 | `PAY_RESTORE` < 0.3% |
| F5 | **Release gate for old iOS (14.x) and data migrations**; staged rollout; crash-safe local store before schema changes | §0.5: six crash waves = 42.5% of crash reviews; three with data loss | No month with ≥ 20 `BUG_CRASH` |
| F6 | **Passcode lock must not be bypassed by an ad dismissal**; audit location permission requests in non-cn locales | §3.3 N10: `13404013818`, `11313989030` | No privacy/lock reports |
| F7 | **Complete English strings — notifications and ads first**; ship Traditional Chinese | §0.7 / §7: top theme in us, ca, au (≈22%) and tw (22.89%) | `LOC_UNTRANS` + `LOC_WANT` below 5% in those storefronts |

## 9.2 Monetization changes to test

| # | Change | Why | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | **Keep the lifetime option and grandfather every past entitlement explicitly** ("you bought X in 2019; you keep X") | §2.4: re-scoping drives `PAY_REGRESS` (mean 2.15) and `PAY_SCAM` (86% 1★); honoured lifetimes drive `DEV_TRUST` (mean 4.93) | Revenue from legacy users — small; trust gain large |
| M2 | **Keep the quota-grows-with-use mechanic and explain it on the paywall** | §0.2: reviewers who understand it praise it (`13289981450`, `13591116003`); `PAY_CAP5` now 0.6% | Low |
| M3 | **Free basic year summary, paid detailed report** | §8.4 Dec 2025: 15 reviews in a month; `13559154241` asks for exactly this split | Low |
| M4 | **Make the ¥8 ad-free SKU visible *before* the first ad**, not discoverable after an ad fails to close | §0.1: `13362003467` reads the SKU as the motive for hostile ads | Could raise conversion and lower `PAY_SCAM` |
| M5 | **Price parity or a single cross-platform membership** | §0.4: `13791604447` (iOS 88 vs Android 48), `10530140312` | Platform-fee constraints |
| M6 | **Onboarding: allow skipping the trial and habit selection; every paywall screen needs a visible back control** | 2026: `14389575364` `14507944819` `14426138907` `14501891567` | Low; watch `PAY_TRIAL` |

## 9.3 Product and retention work

| # | Work | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | **Redesigns ship behind a setting for at least one release** (old focus page, AI titles off, habit balls hidden, compact widget) | §0.6: four redesign waves; `13403164932` proposes decoupled styles |
| R2 | **Protect one-tap check-in and one-tap undo** | §4.1: June 2021 and 2024 regressions |
| R3 | **Photos in check-in logs and notes; browse all logs; autosave** | §4.5: `JRNL_WANT` 668 (3.24%, very strong) — the largest unmet need |
| R4 | **Reminder intelligence:** suppress once done, a silent-mode "strong" alarm, sounds that persist | §4.4: `REM_FAIL` lift 3.62 among payers |
| R5 | **Custom day rollover and multi-check habits linked to reward points** | §3.6 #9–#10: 237 + 218 reviews; 50 rollover mentions |
| R6 | **Apple Watch check-in; interactive iOS widgets** | §4.6: `PLAT_WATCH` 256; widget emotional weight (`5169380786`) |
| R7 | **Icon library: restore removed icons, add study/chores/yoga categories, allow emoji** | §3.6 #3: `DES_ICON_WANT` 561; payers' top request (lift 2.83) |
| R8 | **An in-app feedback channel with a visible reply** | §3.3 N8: `SUP_BAD` 184, payer mean 1.92; fast fixes are among the strongest praise (§3.4 P4) |
| R9 | **Keep the app social-free** | §0.6: `SOC_NOSOCIAL` 120, payer lift 4.55 |

## 9.4 Research questions this corpus cannot answer

- Q1: What share of revenue did the June 2025 ad formats and the ¥8 SKU produce, against churn among active users? (Reviews show cost, not revenue.)
- Q2: How many legacy lifetime buyers exist, and what share lost their entitlement in the 2020 subscription switch?
- Q3: Does the habit quota vary by cohort or test? Reviewers in the same month report 3, 5 and 8.
- Q4: Why is Hong Kong the best-ranked storefront with the lowest public average?
- Q5: Would an English-complete build change US/CA/AU acquisition? The public rating gap is uniform, so ratings won't answer this.
- Q6: Is the ADHD positioning in the listing supported by any user data outside reviews?

## 9.5 What to do first

1. **F1 + F2** — ad mechanics and payer protection. The fastest, largest sentiment recovery; no pricing change needed.
2. **F3 + F4** — restore and entitlement portability. It stops the worst 1★ reviews, from the users who paid.
3. **F5** — a release gate. The next crash wave is statistically due.
4. **R1** — opt-in redesigns, before the next UI change ships.
5. **F7 + R3** — localisation and photos in notes. The largest remaining positive opportunities.

# PART 9.1 — EVIDENCE APPENDIX

## A. Counting rules

1. **Denominator.** Every global percentage divides by **20,634**, the complete corpus with no exclusions (§1.4). Country tables divide by that storefront's review count. Segment rates divide by the named segment and are labelled.
2. **Non-exclusive themes.** 34,191 assignments over 20,634 reviews (1.66 per review). Theme counts must never be summed — use the unions in §3.2, where each review counts once.
3. **`META_LOWINFO` is not exclusive in this corpus.** 4,101 reviews carry it alone; 659 carry it with another code — typically `META_PREUSE` (220), `META_UNLOCK` (116) or a one-word `OUT_DISCIPLINE` / `DES_CUTE`. A review like "打卡自律" (check-in, self-discipline) is both low-information and an outcome signal.
4. **`PAY_BOUGHT` requires a first-person statement** of buying, subscribing, being a member or having paid. "Old member", "lifetime member" and "bought 大太阳" count. Price opinions without purchase do not.
5. **Mean ★ for a theme** is the unweighted mean of the star ratings of every review carrying it.
6. **Bands** are applied to the % of the stated denominator (thresholds in *How to read this*).
7. **Text sub-cuts** (price figures, ad mechanics, "Nth launch", "year statistics", rollover) are regex counts over the title and body *inside* a hand-coded theme or over the whole corpus where stated. They are labelled wherever used and never presented as themes.
8. **Translations** are the analyst's; originals are quoted first.

## D. Judgement calls and known error risk

1. **Low-information threshold.** One-phrase praise ("好用", "不错") is `META_LOWINFO` even when positive. A phrase naming a specific property ("简洁", "可爱", "自律") gets that code, with `META_LOWINFO` added only if nothing else is said. Reversing this would move roughly 600 reviews between `META_LOWINFO` and the aesthetic and outcome codes. No finding depends on the boundary.
2. **`META_UNLOCK` vs later review prompts.** `META_UNLOCK` is reserved for an explicit gate ("评价才能解锁 / 提醒"). Post-2020 Nth-launch prompts were not gated. They are coded `REM_ANNOY` when complained about and otherwise left uncoded, and they are quantified by text census in §1.7 (40 reviews). A reader who treats all prompts as solicitation should add those 40.
3. **Custom day rollover.** These requests (end the day at 2–4 am) were coded `CORE_RETRO` in the first part of the reading and `REQ_OTHER` in later chunks. A text census finds 50 such reviews: 18 in `CORE_RETRO`, 24 in `REQ_OTHER`, 1 in `CORE_FREQ` and 11 in neither, because they were phrased as other complaints. §3.6 cites the census, not either code, for this request.
4. **Quota wording.** `PAY_CAP5` covers any stated free-habit limit (3, 4, 5, 6, 8 or 10), not only five. The code name is historical.
5. **`AD_NEG` spans two ad systems** — splash and promotional ads in 2019–2021, and in-flow ads from 2025. Developer self-promotion (Weibo-follow pop-ups) is split out as `AD_CROSSPROMO` (26).
6. **`DES_REDESIGN` is negative-only.** Positive comments on a new version are coded `DES_PRETTY` / `DEV_TRUST`. This makes `DES_REDESIGN` a complaint count, not a measure of redesign reception.
7. **`PAY_REGRESS` vs `PAY_RESTORE`.** A member who reinstalls and finds no membership is `PAY_RESTORE` (a technical failure) unless they state the entitlement was *withdrawn* (then `PAY_REGRESS`). Ambiguous reinstall cases (`6909488103`) carry both.
8. **Promotional-sounding reviews are kept.** `13662299946` (5★, Jan 2026: perfect exam scores credited to the app, with a military-discipline digression) reads like marketing. It is coded on its content (`OUT_STUDY`, `USER_STUDENT`) and not treated as fake — there is no evidence either way.
9. **Traditional vs Simplified.** tw/hk reviewers writing in Simplified Chinese are not assumed to be mainland users.
10. **`SOC_GROUP_NEG` was declared and never observed.** The app has no groups in any version reviewers describe. It is retained so the taxonomy is complete, and reported as n = 0.

**Known error risk overall:** the headline clusters are unambiguous — ads (§0.1), quota and paywall (§0.2), restore and data loss (§0.3–§0.4), crash waves (§0.5) and localisation (§0.7). They are described in plain words by hundreds of reviewers each. The risk concentrates in one-line reviews and in the request codes, whose boundaries (`REQ_OTHER` vs specific codes) could move individual counts by 5–10%. **No recommendation in Part 9 rests on a theme smaller than 12 reviews**; the smallest (F6, privacy/lock) is included on severity grounds and says so.
